title: Zoho Invoice - Invoice Maker
summary: Generate invoices and estimates, save receipts, and track time from one app.
description:
Zoho Invoice is an online invoicing software packed with all the essentials a small business needs to make their invoicing process a breeze. From raising estimates and striking deals to sending invoices and getting paid, this user-friendly invoicing app comes with all the capabilities your business needs.

Everything you need and more!


Swift invoicing
Cut down your invoicing time and focus on your business. Quickly create professional invoices in just a click. Add your customer's information to the invoice, apply taxes, and email them or send them as a PDF instantly.

Versatile templates
Need an invoice template that fits your business? Fine tune your invoices to match the rhythm of your brand. Choose an invoice template, add your organization logo and signature to enhance authenticity, and alter the font size to align with your business branding.

Efficient expense management
Record all your expenses and categorize them to gain better clarity on your spending. Save receipts for reference and easily bill your customers for the expenses.

Crucial business insights
Make informed business decisions with the help of 30+ business reports or get a holistic overview of your finances from the data-packed dashboard.

Strengthen customer relationships
Provide your customers with a secure portal where they can save their cards for future transactions, view and pay their invoices, accept or negotiate estimates, and share their reviews for the services rendered.
